notes: Schema-valid (W/A is a legal enum unit) but wrong dimension: a detector's responsivity is amperes of photocurrent PER incident watt (A/W), the reciprocal of a laser emitter's W/A slope efficiency. Using the emitter's W/A for a detector inverts the transfer direction. The family unit-scoping check must reject this, since photodiode's responsivity declares unit A/W.
